sentences.text: [deadpan, dry humor] Monopoly was invented to make you hate landlords.
In nineteen oh four, a woman named Lizzie invented it as The Landlord's Game.
One player buys all the land, everyone else pays rent, and goes broke.
It was a warning, and people loved it.
Then a salesman, Charles Darrow, copied it, sold it to Parker Brothers, and became a millionaire.
[after a long pause] Parker Brothers paid Lizzie five hundred dollars.
[deadpan, dry humor] One player took everything, just like her game.
Next: the volcano that only spared a prisoner.
